title: Jazz Path
subtitle: Ten piano-led levels from shells on the blues to 40 standards from a lead sheet: comping, soloing, ballads, Monk and Silver, reharmonisation and modern jazz.
benchmark: Levine's The Jazz Piano Book in 12 keys, Open Studio piano Level 4, a 40-tune book

levels.title: Shells and the blues
levels.goal: Comp a 12-bar blues in F, Bb and C with shells in swing time, play blues heads with melody plus shells, and improvise a chorus with three-note and motif games.
levels.adds: Shells, the blues form, Charleston comping, swing eighths, the blues scale, the first constraint games, the first transcription.

steps.title: Dominant shells 1-3-7 and 1-7-3 on F7, Bb7, C7
steps.setup: A shell drill through the blues. Until then, Voicings, Closest chords, aiming for three-note grips.
steps.done: Both shapes on all three chords, 3 clean runs at 60 in half notes, on two days.
steps.needs: A shell voicing tab in Voicings: 1-3-7 and 1-7-3 through ii-V-I, the blues and 12 keys (jazz rank 4).

steps.title: The blues form with shells, whole notes
steps.setup: Jam: 12-bar blues in F at 80, left-hand shells only.
steps.done: 3 choruses with no wrong chord and no lost bar, on two days.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: shells on the 12-bar blues (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Swing eighths and off-beat accents
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: swing eighths from 100 up to 120. Then Comping: blue third over C7 at 100.
steps.done: Rhythm 90% at 120, 3 runs, on two days; comping 90%.

steps.title: Charleston comping (beat 1 and the and-of-2)
steps.setup: Comping: blue third over C7, F7 and G7 with the Charleston shell. Then Jam, blues in Bb, comping the Charleston (not scored yet).
steps.done: Comping 90% at 110 on all three; one blues chorus in Bb at 110 with the rhythm held.

steps.title: Blues scale and minor pentatonic in F, Bb, C
steps.setup: Scales: blues scale and minor pentatonic, right hand, 2 octaves, eighths at 100, in F, Bb and C.
steps.done: Eighths at 100, 3 clean runs of each scale per key, on two days.

steps.title: Improv game: three notes
steps.setup: Jam: blues in F at 100; the right hand uses only F, Ab, C (then Bb, Db, F over a Bb blues).
steps.done: 4 choruses with 90% of notes from the set and at least 6 two-beat rests per chorus.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: call and response
steps.setup: Jam: blues; the backing plays 2 bars, you answer 2. Until response windows exist, leave bars 1-2, 5-6 and 9-10 empty.
steps.done: 3 choruses where every answer starts inside its window and ends before the next call.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: one rhythmic motif
steps.setup: Jam: blues; keep one 1-bar rhythm (the C Jam two-note riff, or the Charleston) and change the pitches to fit each chord.
steps.done: Same onset pattern in at least 8 of 12 bars, a chord tone on beat 1 in 75% of bars.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).
steps.feeds: C Jam Blues, Now's the Time

steps.title: Learn two blues heads by ear
steps.setup: Learn the head from the record, then check it in Song Studio on the imported lead sheet: wait mode first, then performance. C Jam Blues is judged here; the second head counts on the shelf.
steps.done: C Jam Blues and one more shelf head in performance mode, 90% at 120, on two days.

steps.title: Head plus shells
steps.setup: Two hands: left-hand shell plus right-hand line. Then a shelf head in Song Studio with your own left hand (not counted here yet).
steps.done: Two choruses of a shelf head, melody plus shells, 90% at 110.

steps.title: Three blues licks in three keys
steps.setup: Phrases: the C blues lick, hear first. The blues category in Licks (blue-third grace note, 6-5-b3-1 turnaround, Monk's whole-step trill in F, Bb, C) is still to come. Left-hand companion: the Oscar Peterson blues patterns.
steps.done: The lick clean at 100, hear-first, on two days; later each blues lick in F, Bb and C.

steps.title: Minor blues
steps.setup: Jam: minor blues (Cm7, Fm7, Ab7, G7alt), left-hand shells.
steps.done: 3 choruses at 120 with shells; one three-note chorus (C, Eb, G).
steps.needs: A minor blues in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

steps.title: First transcription: 4 bars
steps.setup: Loop and slow Monk on Bags' Groove (the first phrase of his solo) or Wynton Kelly on Freddie Freeloader (the first 4 bars); sing it, find it on the keys, then play along in Record.
steps.done: The 4 bars along with the recording 3 times in a row.
steps.needs: A transcription loop: loop and slow a bar range of a recording and play along (jazz rank 9).

shelf.title: C Jam Blues
shelf.teaches: Two-note riff head, Charleston comping, the motif game

shelf.title: Sonnymoon for Two
shelf.teaches: Blues-scale riff head, call and response

shelf.title: Blue Monk
shelf.teaches: Chromatic passing chords (Eb7 to Edim), Monk's phrasing

shelf.title: Tenor Madness
shelf.teaches: Blues head with a pickup line

shelf.title: Freddie Freeloader
shelf.teaches: Blues with an Ab7 colour, Wynton Kelly's swing

scores.label: Later: Wynton Kelly solo with ghost notes

shelf.title: Watermelon Man
shelf.teaches: 16-bar funk blues, even eighths, a left-hand riff

levels.test: Two shelf heads at 120 with melody plus shells; one chorus of comping with the Charleston in Bb at 120; one improvised chorus in F that passes the three-note game (90% set notes, 6 rests) and lands a chord tone on beat 1 in 75% of bars.

levels.title: Guide tones and the first standards
levels.goal: Play the first standards through rungs a to c of the tune ladder and solo with guide tones and arpeggios over major and minor ii-V-I.
levels.adds: Diatonic 7th chords, shells and guide tones through ii-V-I in 12 keys, minor ii-V-i, 32-bar forms, bossa comping, chord-tone soloing, the first licks.

steps.title: Diatonic 7th chords in C, F, Bb, G
steps.setup: Each degree's seventh chord, up and down the key in root position.
steps.done: Up and down the key, 3 clean runs at 80 in each key.
steps.needs: Seventh-chord arpeggios on each degree in Scales, or a diatonic sevenths tab in Voicings.

steps.title: Shells through major ii-V-I, 12 keys
steps.setup: A shell drill on ii-V-I, alternating 1-7-3 and 1-3-7.
steps.done: All 12 keys clean at 60 in half notes, on two days.
steps.needs: A shell voicing tab in Voicings: 1-3-7 and 1-7-3 through ii-V-I, the blues and 12 keys (jazz rank 4).
steps.feeds: Autumn Leaves, Fly Me to the Moon

steps.title: Guide tones 3-7 through ii-V-I
steps.setup: Voicings, Guide tones: one key, then three, then 12.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95%, on two days.

steps.title: Minor ii-V-i shells and guide tones
steps.setup: Voicings, Minor ii-V-i (rootless) through 12 keys. A minor shell tab is still to come.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95%, on two days.

steps.title: Hear the difference
steps.setup: Ear, chord qualities: m7, 7, maj7 and m7b5. Then progressions with sevenths, major ii-V-I and minor ii-V-i.
steps.done: 20 in a row at 90%.

steps.title: Comp ii-V-I in time
steps.setup: Jam: ii-V-I and minor ii-V-i, left-hand shells, half notes at 100.
steps.done: 8 bars in each of 4 keys, no wrong chord.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: shells on ii-V-I (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Rung a on two shelf tunes
steps.setup: Song Studio on the imported lead sheet: roots in the left hand, melody in the right. Autumn Leaves is judged here; do a second tune too.
steps.done: Performance mode 90% at the shelf tempo, on two days, for two tunes.

steps.title: Rung b: guide tones through the form
steps.setup: The tune player (Jam with the tune's changes). Until then, Song Studio with only 3rds and 7ths in the left hand.
steps.done: Two choruses with no wrong guide tone, at 80% of the shelf tempo.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Rung c: melody plus shells
steps.setup: Song Studio with your own shells under the melody; warm up in Two hands, shell plus line.
steps.done: Two choruses 90% at the shelf tempo.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Bossa comping
steps.setup: A bossa rhythm in Comping over Jam, with a bossa backing.
steps.done: Blue Bossa, 2 choruses at 130 with the bossa rhythm, 90%.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: a bossa rhythm (jazz rank 2).
steps.feeds: Blue Bossa, Song for My Father

steps.title: Improv game: guide tones only
steps.setup: Jam on a shelf tune; the right hand plays only 3rds and 7ths, one per bar, then two per bar.
steps.done: A 3rd or 7th within a beat of 80% of the changes, two choruses.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: arpeggios
steps.setup: Chord scales, major and minor ii-V-I in three keys. Then Jam: 1-3-5-7 up on each chord, then 3-5-7-9 (the chorus is not scored yet).
steps.done: Chord scales clean in 3 keys, both changes; one chorus with chord tones on 80% of strong beats.

steps.title: Four licks in three keys
steps.setup: Licks: major ii-V-I licks 1 and 4, minor ii-V-i licks 18 and 19; hear first, then three keys round the cycle.
steps.done: Each lick at 120 in three keys, on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe a melody
steps.setup: The first 8 bars of Blue Bossa (Joe Henderson) or Autumn Leaves (Miles on Somethin' Else): sing and play back, then play along.
steps.done: Play along with the record 3 times.
steps.needs: A transcription loop: loop and slow a bar range of a recording and play along (jazz rank 9).

shelf.title: Autumn Leaves
shelf.teaches: Major and minor ii-V in one tune
shelf.detail: G minor and Bb major, AABC 32, 120

scores.label: Later: Bill Evans, Portrait in Jazz

shelf.title: Summertime
shelf.teaches: Slow minor, melody with shells, blues inflection

shelf.title: Blue Bossa
shelf.teaches: Minor ii-V-i, one modulation to Db, bossa

shelf.title: Song for My Father
shelf.teaches: Minor latin groove, left-hand bass ostinato

levels.test: Two shelf tunes through rungs a to c at tempo; shells through major and minor ii-V-I in 12 keys at 80; one chorus on Autumn Leaves passing the guide-tone game (80% of changes landed).

levels.title: Rootless voicings and comping in time
levels.goal: Comp any shelf tune with rootless A and B voicings on real comping rhythms, solo a chorus with chord tones and approach notes, and finish the whole ladder (a to f) on two tunes.
levels.adds: Rootless voicings in time, comping rhythms, two-feel bass, secondary dominants and chained ii-Vs, chromatic approach notes, the second key.

steps.title: Rootless A and B through major ii-V-I
steps.setup: Voicings, Major ii-V-I: 1 key, 3 keys, 12 keys; start in position A, then B.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95% from both starting forms, on two days.

steps.title: Rootless minor ii-V-i
steps.setup: Voicings, Minor ii-V-i through 12 keys.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95%, on two days.
steps.feeds: Afternoon in Paris, Girl from Ipanema

steps.title: Rootless dominants on the blues (7-9-3-13, 3-13-7-9)
steps.setup: Rootless dominants through the F and Bb blues.
steps.done: F and Bb blues, two choruses each, 95%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: rootless blues dominants (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Rootless in time
steps.setup: Rootless voicings on the beat: an in-time option in Voicings, or Jam ii-V-I comping in half notes at 100.
steps.done: 4 keys, half notes at 100, 90% voicings.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: rootless voicings on ii-V-I, or an in-time option in Voicings (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Comping rhythms
steps.setup: A comping rhythm library over Jam: two-feel half notes, Charleston, anticipated and-of-4, Red Garland's and-of-2 and and-of-4.
steps.done: Each rhythm 2 choruses at 120, 90% on the slots.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: a library of comping rhythms (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Two-feel bass under shells
steps.setup: Left hand root and 5th in half notes, right hand shells; then a walking line on the blues.
steps.done: One Bb blues chorus at 100, quarter-note walk, 90%.
steps.needs: A Two hands pattern: two-feel and walking bass under shells (jazz rank 8).

steps.title: Secondary dominants and chained ii-Vs
steps.setup: Ear, progressions with secondary dominants; Jam on the All of Me and Satin Doll changes.
steps.done: Name each chord's function on the shelf chart without errors; comp it once through.
steps.needs: Secondary dominants in Progression dictation, and All of Me and Satin Doll in Jam.

steps.title: Rung d on two shelf tunes
steps.setup: The tune player: rootless voicings on a comping rhythm, no melody.
steps.done: Two choruses, 90% correct voicings on the comping rhythm.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Improv game: approach notes
steps.setup: Jam on a shelf tune: every chord tone on beat 1 approached by a half step from below, then from above.
steps.done: 80% of bar downbeats are chord tones approached chromatically, one chorus.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Rung e on two shelf tunes
steps.setup: Jam over the tune, recorded, scored for chord tones and guide-tone landings.
steps.done: One chorus with chord tones on 75% of strong beats and 70% guide-tone landings.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Rung f: second key
steps.setup: Transpose the tune in Song Studio and the tune player: down a 4th, or the key a singer would ask for.
steps.done: Rungs a and c in the new key at 85%, one day, on one tune.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Four more licks in six keys
steps.setup: Licks: major ii-V-I licks 5 and 9, ii-V-I-VI licks 12 and 13; six keys round the cycle.
steps.done: Each lick at 140 in six keys, on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe comping rhythm
steps.setup: Red Garland's comping under Miles on "Bye Bye Blackbird" (first chorus): rhythm only, then with voicings.
steps.done: Tap the comping rhythm with the record, 8 bars, 90%.
steps.needs: A transcription loop: loop and slow a bar range of a recording and play along (jazz rank 9).

levels.test: One shelf tune through all six rungs (a to f) at tempo; rootless ii-V-I in 12 keys in time at 100; two choruses of comping on a second tune with two different comping rhythms. Do the full ladder on two shelf tunes.

levels.title: Modal jazz: So What, quartal and Herbie
levels.goal: Comp and solo over modal tunes and vamps with So What, quartal and sus voicings, pentatonic lines and developed motifs.
levels.adds: Modes by ear, So What chords, quartal stacks, sus and slash ("Herbie") voicings, pentatonic superimposition, motif development, space.

steps.title: Hear the modes
steps.setup: Ear, scales and modes: dorian, mixolydian, lydian, phrygian and aeolian.
steps.done: 20 in a row at 85%.

steps.title: Dorian, mixolydian and lydian fingering in D, Eb, F, C
steps.setup: Scales: dorian, mixolydian and lydian, 2 octaves, hands together, in D, Eb, F and C.
steps.done: 2 octaves hands together at 100, 3 clean runs of each mode.

steps.title: So What voicing (three 4ths plus a major 3rd)
steps.setup: Diatonic So What chords up and down D dorian, then Eb dorian.
steps.done: All 7 positions up and down at 80, then in Eb dorian.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: So What chords (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Three- and four-note quartal stacks (McCoy)
steps.setup: Left-hand stacks of 4ths moving diatonically.
steps.done: D dorian and F dorian, 2 octaves, at 80.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: quartal stacks (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Modal vamp comping
steps.setup: Jam: modal vamp, then the So What form (16 bars D dorian, 8 Eb, 8 D).
steps.done: 2 choruses at 135 with So What chords, the comping rhythm held.
steps.needs: The So What form in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

steps.title: Sus and slash voicings (Herbie)
steps.setup: 9sus as Bb/C, Gm7/C, left-hand 5th plus right-hand triad.
steps.done: D7sus, F7sus, Eb7sus, Db7sus (the Maiden Voyage set) clean at 80.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: sus and slash chords (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: The Cantaloupe Island and Watermelon Man riffs
steps.setup: Phrases: the left-hand riff plus the right-hand comp.
steps.done: Each riff 4 times through at 110, 90%.
steps.needs: Phrases entries: the Cantaloupe Island and Watermelon Man riffs.

steps.title: Improv game: pentatonics on a dorian chord
steps.setup: Jam, modal: over Dm7 play D, E, then A minor pentatonic, 4 bars each.
steps.done: One chorus per pentatonic with 90% inside the set.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: motif development
steps.setup: Jam, modal vamp: one 2-bar motif, then repeat, transpose, invert and displace it by a beat. Until it is scored, check a recording.
steps.done: One chorus where the motif returns at least 4 times, varied.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: space
steps.setup: Jam: play 2 bars, rest 2 bars for a whole chorus; then 1 on, 1 off.
steps.done: 2 choruses with every rest window silent.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Ladder rungs a, c, d, e on two shelf tunes
steps.setup: Song Studio and the tune player.
steps.done: Rungs a, c, d and e done on two tunes.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Transcribe the So What call and response
steps.setup: Bill Evans' two-chord answer to the bass in the head of "So What", then Herbie's comping on "Cantaloupe Island" (first 8 bars).
steps.done: Both along with the record 3 times.
steps.needs: A transcription loop: loop and slow a bar range of a recording and play along (jazz rank 9).

levels.title: Bebop vocabulary and the bebop blues
levels.goal: Play bebop blues heads and solo with eighth-note lines that put chord tones on the beat, using enclosures, the bebop scale and Parker-style licks.
levels.adds: Bebop dominant scale, enclosures, chromatic approach patterns, Bird blues changes, comping sparsely under your own line, tempo up to 180.

steps.title: Bebop dominant scale from each chord tone, descending
steps.setup: Scales: bebop dominant on F and Bb, eighths, descending. Starting from the 3rd, 5th and b7 is not in Scales yet; Chord scales covers the dominant in a ii-V-I.
steps.done: F7 and Bb7 at 140 in eighths, chord tones on the beat, 3 clean runs each.

steps.title: Enclosures into the 3rd and the root
steps.setup: Scale step above, half step below, then the target.
steps.done: 4 enclosure shapes in 6 keys at 120.
steps.needs: A Licks category: bebop enclosures (jazz rank 7).

steps.title: Arpeggio patterns: 1-2-3-5 and 3-5-7-9 on ii-V-I
steps.setup: Chord scales with a pattern mode.
steps.done: 12 keys at 120.
steps.needs: A pattern mode in Chord scales: 1-2-3-5 and 3-5-7-9 on each chord.

steps.title: Rootless dominants with 9 and 13 under a line
steps.setup: Two hands, shell plus line, with a rootless left hand; then Jam, blues.
steps.done: One F blues chorus: rootless left-hand stabs on the and-of-2 and 4 under a right-hand bebop line, 90% voicings.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: rootless stabs under your own line (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Bird blues changes
steps.setup: Ear, follow the bass, then Jam on the Bird blues (Fmaj7, Em7b5 A7, Dm7 G7, Cm7 F7 ...).
steps.done: Comp 2 choruses at 140 with shells, then rootless.
steps.needs: The Bird blues in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

steps.title: Bebop heads by ear
steps.setup: Learn from the record, check in Song Studio. Now's the Time is judged here; do a second head too.
steps.done: 2 shelf heads in performance mode, 90% at 160.

steps.title: Six bebop blues licks in all 12 keys
steps.setup: Licks, blues and bebop categories, hear first.
steps.done: Each lick in 12 keys at 140 over a week, interleaved.
steps.needs: A Licks category: blues and bebop lines in 12 keys (jazz rank 7).

steps.title: Improv game: eighth-note lines
steps.setup: Jam: F blues at 140, continuous eighths for 4 bars, then rest 2 bars.
steps.done: Two choruses with chord tones on 80% of beats 1 and 3.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: start on the and-of-1
steps.setup: Jam: every phrase starts off the beat (the and-of-1 or the and-of-4).
steps.done: 80% of phrase starts off the beat, two choruses.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Ladder rungs a to e on two shelf tunes
steps.setup: Song Studio and the tune player.
steps.done: Rungs a to e done on two tunes.
steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Tempo ladder on the blues
steps.setup: Jam: blues at 140, then 160, then 180; rootless comping plus one solo chorus.
steps.done: A clean chorus at 180.
steps.needs: Comping and improvisation scoring in Jam (jazz ranks 2 and 3).

steps.title: Transcribe a bebop chorus
steps.setup: Wynton Kelly's first chorus on "Freddie Freeloader" or Parker's first chorus on "Now's the Time": learn it at 70% speed, then 100%.
steps.done: The chorus along with the record at full speed, 3 times.
steps.needs: A transcription loop: loop and slow a bar range of a recording and play along (jazz rank 9).

steps.setup: Yardbird Suite through rungs a, c and d.
steps.done: Rungs a, c and d done.

levels.title: Rhythm changes, tritone subs and tempo
levels.goal: Play rhythm-changes heads in Bb at 180, comp the A section and the dominant-cycle bridge, and solo with tritone-sub and altered colours.
levels.adds: I-VI-ii-V variants, the III7-VI7-II7-V7 bridge, tritone substitution, altered dominants and upper structures, a stride-lite left hand, faster tempos.

steps.title: Rhythm changes A section variants
steps.setup: Jam: rhythm changes (Bb6 G7 Cm7 F7; Bb Bdim Cm7 C#dim; Dm7 G7 Cm7 F7; Bb7 Eb7 Edim).
steps.done: Shells, then rootless, 2 choruses at 140, 95%.
steps.needs: Rhythm changes in Bb in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

steps.title: The bridge: dominant cycle
steps.setup: Rootless dominants D7 G7 C7 F7, 2 bars each, A and B forms alternating.
steps.done: 12 keys of the cycle at 120, 95%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: rootless dominants round the cycle (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Hear and play the tritone sub
steps.setup: Ear, progressions: ii-bII7-I against ii-V-I. A tritone-sub option in Voicings: the same guide tones over a new root.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95%; 20 in a row by ear at 85%.
steps.needs: A tritone-sub option in Voicings, and bII7 in Progression dictation.

steps.title: Altered dominants and upper structures
steps.setup: Voicings, Altered through 12 keys. An upper-structure drill (US II, bIII and bVI over a 3-7 shell, from the data the app already has) is still to come.
steps.done: Altered in 12 keys at 95%; later US II and bVI in 6 keys.

steps.title: Lines: altered scale and tritone-sub lines into I
steps.setup: Licks: the altered lines 9 and 10 (major) and 23 and 24 (minor), in six keys. A tritone-sub category in Licks is still to come.

steps.title: Improv game: the bridge only

steps.done: 4 bridges with 85% guide-tone landings.

steps.title: Improv game: quote the head

steps.done: One chorus with the head fragment in all 3 A sections.

levels.title: Ballads, block chords and solo piano
levels.goal: Play ballads as solo piano with two-handed voicings, harmonise a melody in block chords (drop-2, locked hands, Red Garland), and play a jazz waltz.
levels.adds: Two-handed rootless voicings, drop-2 and four-way close, Shearing locked hands, Garland block chords, ballad and solo-piano left hands, rubato intros and tags, 3/4 comping, Evans voicings.

steps.title: Two-handed rootless voicings
steps.setup: Left hand 3-7 (or 7-3), right hand 9-5-13 or 5-9-1; ii-V-I in 12 keys.
steps.done: 12 keys at 95%, onset spread under 40 ms.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: two-handed rootless (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Ballad left hands
steps.setup: Root-7th or root-10th on 1 and a mid voicing on 3; walking tenths; rolled spreads.
steps.done: The Misty A section at 60 with each pattern, 90%.
steps.needs: A Two hands pattern: ballad left hands (root-7th, tenths, rolled spreads) (jazz rank 8).

steps.title: Pedal and voicing balance
steps.setup: Pedal: legato pedalling through a progression. The velocity check in Song Studio (melody louder than the inner voices) is still to come.
steps.done: Pedal 90%, on two days; later the melody over 10 velocity points above the inner voices on 80% of chords.

steps.title: Four-way close and drop-2
steps.setup: Given a melody note and a chord symbol, play 4-way close, then drop-2.
steps.done: 16 bars of a shelf melody at 70 in each form, 90%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: block chords on a tune's melody (4-way close, drop-2) (jazz rank 5).
steps.feeds: Lullaby of Birdland, Darn That Dream

steps.title: Shearing locked hands
steps.setup: Melody doubled an octave below in the left hand, 4-way close in the right; a diminished chord on passing notes.
steps.done: One A section of Lullaby of Birdland at 120, 90%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: Shearing locked hands on a tune's melody (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Red Garland block chords
steps.setup: Left hand 3-7-9, right-hand melody in octaves with the 5th inside.
steps.done: 8 bars of a blues solo in block chords at 120.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: Red Garland block chords (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Melody embellishment and fills
steps.setup: Jam over a ballad backing: play the melody and fill only in its rests with 2-to-4-note fills.
steps.done: One chorus: melody 90% recognisable, a fill in at least 6 rests.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Intros, endings and tags
steps.setup: Phrases: the I-vi-ii-V intro, the iii-VI-ii-V tag, the "Basie ending" and the rubato last-4-bars intro.
steps.done: Each in 3 keys at 80.
steps.needs: Phrases entries: jazz intros, tags and endings in 3 keys.

steps.title: Bill Evans voicings
steps.setup: Voicings, Major ii-V-I from position B (rootless with 9 and 13), then Evans spreads (left hand 7-3-6 or 3-7-9, right-hand melody plus one voice).
steps.done: Blue in Green changes with spread voicings at 60, 90%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: Evans spreads (jazz rank 5).
steps.feeds: Blue in Green, Waltz for Debby

steps.title: Jazz waltz comping

steps.needs: A 3/4 swing backing in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

levels.title: Monk and Silver
levels.goal: Play Monk and Silver tunes in their style (Monk's angular voicings and space, Silver's funky hard-bop grooves and left-hand punches), solo by developing the head, then write a head of your own.
levels.adds: Whole-tone and minor-second sounds, displacement, melodic paraphrase, hard-bop comping, latin and gospel grooves, composing a head.

steps.title: Whole-tone scale and Monk runs
steps.setup: Scales: whole-tone from C and from Db (the two collections), 2 octaves; then descending runs over a dominant.
steps.done: 2 octaves at 120 in both whole-tone collections.

steps.title: Monk voicings: b9 clusters and 7th plus root
steps.setup: Shells with a minor 2nd on top (3-b7-1, 7-3-b9).
steps.done: Blue Monk and Well You Needn't changes at 100, 90%.
steps.needs: A voicing type in Voicings: Monk clusters (jazz rank 5).

steps.title: Half-step chord shifts
steps.setup: Jam on Well You Needn't (F7 Gb7) and Epistrophy (Db7 D7).
steps.done: 2 choruses at 160, rootless, 90%.
steps.needs: Well You Needn't and Epistrophy in Jam, with comping scored over it (jazz ranks 2 and 6).

steps.title: Improv game: displacement
steps.setup: Jam, blues: one 3-note motif, started one beat later each bar (the Straight, No Chaser idea).
steps.done: One chorus with the motif in 8 bars, each displaced.
steps.needs: Improvisation scoring and constraint games in Jam (jazz rank 3).

steps.title: Improv game: melodic paraphrase
steps.setup: Jam over Blue Monk (a Bb blues): solo only by changing the head's rhythm, register and order, Monk's own method. Record it and listen back.
steps.done: One chorus where the head stays recognisable throughout, checked on the recording.

steps.title: Hard-bop comping and Silver's left-hand punches
steps.setup: Hits with the drummer on the and-of-4, left-hand octave stabs.
steps.done: 2 choruses of the Sister Sadie changes at 150.
steps.needs: Comping in time over any Jam progression: hard-bop hits and octave stabs (jazz rank 2).

steps.title: Silver's grooves

steps.done: Each groove 4 times at tempo, 90%.
steps.needs: Phrases entries: Silver's grooves.

steps.title: Silver's soloing devices

levels.title: Reharmonisation and key-centre standards
levels.goal: Analyse a standard's key centres, solo through them, and reharmonise a simple standard with tritone subs, related ii-Vs, backdoor and passing chords.
levels.adds: Lead-sheet analysis, melodic-minor harmony (lydian dominant, altered, locrian #2), the reharm toolkit, upper structures in context, controlled outside playing.

steps.title: Lead-sheet analysis
steps.setup: Mark each bar's key centre and function on a shelf tune; the circle of fifths for each key's chords.
steps.done: All the Things You Are analysed with no errors against the key.
steps.needs: An analysis mode: mark each bar's key centre and function on a tune.
steps.feeds: All the Things You Are, Stella

steps.title: Hear key changes
steps.setup: Ear, progressions: a ii-V to a new key (up a 4th, down a 3rd, up a half step).
steps.done: 20 in a row at 85%.
steps.needs: Key changes in Progression dictation: a ii-V to a new key.

steps.title: m7b5 and minor ii-V voicings in context

steps.needs: The tune player: a tune's form and changes in Jam, with the ladder rungs as steps (jazz rank 1).

steps.title: Melodic-minor sounds

steps.done: Melodic minor clean in 12 keys at 120.

steps.needs: An upper-structure drill (US II, bIII and bVI over a shell) on a tune's changes (jazz ranks 1 and 5).

steps.title: Reharm toolkit, one device at a time
steps.setup: On Jam: tritone sub, related ii before each V, backdoor ii-V (iv7 to bVII7), secondary dominants, passing diminished, chromatic ii-V approach.
steps.done: Each device applied to Fly Me to the Moon and comped once, 90%.
steps.needs: A reharmonisation sandbox on Jam (jazz rank 10).

steps.title: Reharmonise a standard

steps.done: Chart written, played as melody plus two-handed voicings, recorded.
